text: {"sql": "SELECT i.machine_id, i.station_id, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(CAST(i.false_alarm AS INT)) AS false_alarm_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(i.false_alarm AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 1) AS false_alarm_share_pct, ROUND(AVG(i.downtime_min), 1) AS avg_downtime_min, ROUND(AVG(i.outdoor_temp_c), 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_c FROM sf_ops.incidents i WHERE i.kind = 'machine_overheat' GROUP BY i.machine_id, i.station_id ORDER BY false_alarm_share_pct DESC, incident_count DESC", "columns": ["machine_id", "station_id", "incident_count", "false_alarm_count", "false_alarm_share_pct", "avg_downtime_min", "avg_outdoor_temp_c"], "purpose": "Aggregate machine_overheat incidents by machine and station to compute false-alarm share, average downtime, and average outdoor temperature."}

data.sql: SELECT i.machine_id, i.station_id, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(CAST(i.false_alarm AS INT)) AS false_alarm_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(i.false_alarm AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 1) AS false_alarm_share_pct, ROUND(AVG(i.downtime_min), 1) AS avg_downtime_min, ROUND(AVG(i.outdoor_temp_c), 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_c FROM sf_ops.incidents i WHERE i.kind = 'machine_overheat' GROUP BY i.machine_id, i.station_id ORDER BY false_alarm_share_pct DESC, incident_count DESC
data.purpose: Aggregate machine_overheat incidents by machine and station to compute false-alarm share, average downtime, and average outdoor temperature.
